tools.name: go_to_checkout
tools.description: Navigate the user to the checkout page. Only useful if the shopping basket already contains items.

tools.name: open_blog_index
tools.description: Open the touriDat blog index listing all published articles.

tools.name: open_blog_post
tools.description: Open a touriDat blog post by slug. Use when the user asks to read a specific article.

slug.description: URL slug of the blog post, e.g. 'unentdeckte-wellnessoasen-deutschland'.

tools.name: open_category
tools.description: Navigate to a touriDat category listing page (brand, theme, or voucher family). Use when the user asks to browse a category, e.g. 'show all wellness offers' or 'open the gift vouchers category'.

path.description: Category path under /kategorien/, without leading slash, e.g. 'deluxe', 'reisethemen/wellness', 'marken/a-rosa'.

tools.name: open_host
tools.description: Open the detail page of a touriDat accommodation (Host). Use when the user wants to view a specific hotel or property they've seen in results.

slug.description: URL slug of the host, usually the last path segment of a /gastgeber/<slug> URL.

tools.name: open_map
tools.description: Open the interactive map view of touriDat accommodations. Use when the user asks to 'see on a map' or 'browse by location'.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search touriDat for travel vouchers and accommodations. Navigates the user to the search results page for the given query. Use for any request of the form 'find X', 'show me Y'.

query.description: Natural-language search term, e.g. 'Wellness Schwarzwald' or 'Sylt 4 Tage'.

maxPrice.description: Optional upper price bound in EUR.

tools.name: view_favorites
tools.description: Open the user's saved favorites list. Requires the user to be logged in; otherwise they'll be redirected to the login page.
